note: DEMO ONLY — hand-authored roadmap fixture for the Facebook-page-not-working problem. Plans hires only; no diagnosis or promised results. Do not treat as live model output.
aliases: my Facebook page gets no engagement
disclaimer: This is a hiring plan and cost estimate only, not a guarantee of results. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice.

steps.title: Hire a social media specialist to restructure the page
steps.why: When a Facebook page stalls, the content plan and posting rhythm are the first things worth a professional look. A specialist can set up a schedule and caption approach systematically.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for fresh product or shop photos
steps.why: Image quality is the page's first impression. A batch of high-quality photos makes every post after it stronger.

steps.title: Hire a Burmese content writer for captions
steps.why: Captions that only announce the product rarely hold attention. A content writer can produce copy that speaks to the customer regularly.

steps.title: Trial a batch of TikTok / Reels short-form video
steps.why: Short-form video typically reaches further than static posts. A small starter batch lets you test without a big commitment.
